paite: Tuipi piau a ka dinleh tuipi a kipan gamsa khat, kii sawm leh lu sagih nei, akiite tung a lallukhu sawm om chiat, alutungte a Pathian gensiatna om, hong paikhetou ka mu hi.
heading: Gam Sahangte Muhna
english: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.

paite: Ka gamsa muh gialbem abang a, akhe vompi khe abang a, akam humpinelkai kam abang hi; dragon in athuneihna thupi leh alaltutphah leh athilhihtheihnate amah apia hi.
english: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.

paite: Alute lak a khat sihpih khop hial dia liam hileh kilawm in ka mu hi; sihpih khop hial dia liam pen hihdam in a-om a; huchi in leitung pumpi in huai gamsa lamdang sa in azuita uhi.
english: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.

paite: Dragon, gamsa kiang a athuneihna petu abia ua; huchi in hiai gamsa abiak kawm in, "Hiai gamsa bang kua a-om a, amah kidoupih thei kua om ahia?" achi uhi.
english: They worshiped the dragon because he gave his authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?”

paite: Huan gamsa kiang ah thil thupite leh Pathian gensiatnate genna ding kam piak in a-om a, huan akiang ah thuneihna piak in a-om hi; kha sawmli-le-nih thilhihtheihna piak ahi.
english: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.

paite: Pathian gensiatna ding, amin gense ding leh a-omna, van a tengte ngei gensia in akamkata hi.
english: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, his dwelling, and those who dwell in heaven.

paite: Huan dragon in gamsa kiang ah misiangthoute kidoupih ding leh amaute zou ding in phalna apia a; chi chih, pau chih leh nam chih tung a thuneihna leng apia hi.
english: It was given to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.

paite: Huan khovel om tung a pan thahsa Belamnou' hinna laibu a amin tuangloute tengteng leh leitung a teng tengteng in amah abe ding uhi.
english: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.

paite: "Kuapeuh zakna ding bil nei in, za hen!"
english: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.

paite: Kuapeuh sal a pi dingte sal a pi in a-om ding; kuapeuh namsau a thah dingte namsau a thah in a-om ding. Hiai ah misiangthoute kuhkalna leh ginna nei ding a chial ahi uh.
english: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

paite: Huan gamsa dang khat leitung a kipat a hong pawtkhetou ka mu a; belamnou bang in kii nih anei a, dragon bang in thu agen hi.
english: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.

paite: Gamsa masapen thuneihna tengteng amitmuh in azang hi. Leitung leh asung a teng tengteng gamsa masapen, si khop hial a liam hihdam a om, be ding in asawl hi.
english: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.

paite: Huan mite mitmuh in van a kipan in leitung a mei kesuk thei khop in thillamdang pipi ahih hi.
english: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.

paite: Huan gamsa sik leh amitmuh a thillamdang hihtheihna piak a a-omna in ama'n leitung a tengte akhem a; huai gamsa namsau a satliam leh dam nawn lim bawl ding in lei a tengte thu apia hi.
english: He deceives my own people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast, saying to those who dwell on the earth that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.

paite: Gamsa masa lim a nakna pe ding leh tua gamsa apau theihna ding in dragon in amah kiang ah thilhihtheihna apia a, huchi a gamsa lim be nuam lou tengteng leng athahsak theihna ding in.
english: It was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn’t worship the image of the beast to be killed.

paite: Mi tengteng, aneu leh alian, azawng ahau, sikha leh sikha lou, akhut taklam uh hiam, atal uh hiam ah chiamtehna piak in a-om chiat uhi;
english: He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given marks on their right hands or on their foreheads;

paite: huchi a kuamah in huai chiamtehna hiam, gamsa min hiam, ahihkeileh amin nambat neiloute'n lei thei lou hiam, zuak thei lou a a-omna ding in.
english: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell unless he has that mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of his name.

paite: Hiai ah pilna a-om hi. Kuapeuh theihsiamna nei in, gamsa nambat sutkhia hen; huai lah mihing nambat ahi ngal a; huan ama nambat tuh zaguk sawmguk-le-guk ahi.
english: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.
